api_inventory.method: go list ./... plus go/parser/go/ast inventory and go test -json

risk_adaptation.generic_scope: The repository exports generic containers and callback-based enumerable APIs; the bridge uses comparable int/string instantiations and excludes callbacks from the serializable boundary.
risk_adaptation.ordering_scope: Hash containers are checked as sets or sorted before comparison; linked and tree containers retain their documented order.
risk_adaptation.dependency_scope: The frozen revision has no external runtime requirements; the private module closure contains the exact go.mod, go.sum, and vendor/modules.txt contract.

private_assertion_classes: array and linked list mutation, bounds, sorting, and copies
stack LIFO and queue FIFO semantics
circular buffer overwrite and full state
hash, linked, and ordered map lookup and range queries
hash and tree set uniqueness and set algebra
binary heap ordering and bulk push
malformed bridge input, bounded subprocess behavior, and verifier-owned scoring

candidate_bridge_build.command: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 GOWORK=off GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go build -mod=vendor -o bridge ./cmd/bridge
